fields.Description: This page from the International Cheese Federation's archive for July 2019 features a collection of blog posts covering industry news, a member spotlight, and event announcements. Key topics include federal dairy margin payments, record-high cheddar prices driven by export demand, a small-batch producer's experience with competition entries, and details for the upcoming Annual Conference.

Yuri Lee 




 


Three months of safety-net payments in a row 

 

The federal dairy margin program has now triggered a payment for three straight months this year. Here’s what a run like that does and doesn’t tell you about your own numbers.

Yuri Lee 




 


The wheel she almost didn’t enter 

 

With competition entries due ahead of this month’s Annual Conference, one small-batch producer on the wheel she nearly left off her entry list, and the documentation habit that changed her mind.

Cheddar closes June at a three-year high 

 

Block and barrel cheddar closed June at prices not seen since late 2016, with firmer export demand doing a lot of the work. What that does and doesn’t mean for your milk check.
